rows.label: Fix ALL issues (incl. WARNING) — Dispatch fixer on every finding
Fix NIT and higher — Skip WARNING-only findings
Fix MINOR and higher — Skip NIT and WARNING
Fix MAJOR and higher — Only fix publish-blockers (and CRITICALs)
Fix CRITICAL only — Strictest mode (loaders/security blockers only)
End — Done; exit without running the fixer
